entities.name: Fallaji invasion of Korlis
entities.description: A failed invasion of Korlis by Ashnod's Fallaji Empire forces at Kher Ridges during the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: A woman general of the Fallaji Empire who led the campaign against Korlis and was defeated.

entities.name: Fallaji Empire
entities.description: Mishra's empire, whose forces invaded Korlis.

entities.name: Korlis
entities.description: A nation that sided with Urza and repelled the Fallaji invasion.

entities.name: Jarin
entities.description: A Fallaji Empire war captain who did not respect Ashnod.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The artificer whom Korlis sided with.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Ruler of the Fallaji Empire, who supplied dragon engines.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war during which the invasion took place.

entities.name: Kher Ridges
entities.description: The mountain location of the failed invasion.

entities.name: Sarinth
entities.description: The place Ashnod was sent to secure allegiance.

events.summary: Ashnod, appointed general to conquer Korlis, leads the Fallaji army to the Kher Ridges with Mishra's dragon engines.
events.quote: She was appointed general of this particular campaign, to the dismay of the Fallaji Empire war captains like Jarin .

events.summary: A Korlisian army attacks, the transmogrants are destroyed and Ashnod retreats.
events.quote: the transmogrants were all destroyed, and Ashnod had to retreat.

events.summary: Ashnod returns to Mishra's Fortress in defeat and is sent to Sarinth.
events.quote: She returned to Mishra's Fortress in defeat and was promptly sent to Sarinth to secure their allegiance

relations.note: She was a general of its forces.

relations.quote: conquer Korlis for having sided with Urza
